name: strike-v3
reason: Заказчик повторно указал на некорректную анатомию рук в ударе.
prompt:
Repaint MIRA'S KNIFE ATTACK with anatomically correct arms and hands. Reference1 is her correct idle appearance and equipment; reference2 is her face. Keep exactly this woman, face, dark green hood and cape, leather cuirass and bracers, linen sleeves, boots, rope and scroll. ONE full-body dynamic lunge facing SCREEN RIGHT, front knee bent, rear leg extended and cloak trailing left. THREE QUARTER side view. Bow and quiver stowed on back; empty dagger sheath at belt.
PRIORITY: draw TWO NORMAL HUMAN ARMS with clear uninterrupted shoulder-upper arm-elbow-forearm-wrist-hand anatomy. No extra joints, twisted wrists, mismatched arm lengths, fused fingers or detached hands. RIGHT arm is the weapon arm. Rotate her RIGHT shoulder forward, RIGHT upper arm comes down from that shoulder to a clearly visible elbow at lower chest height; RIGHT forearm reaches forward toward SCREEN RIGHT. Keep elbow slightly bent, and wrist straight in line with forearm. RIGHT hand is a normal compact closed fist around the handle of ONE short dagger in REVERSE / ICEPICK GRIP: thumb securely wraps over index finger near the pommel at TOP of fist; FOUR fingers curl around the handle, little finger at BOTTOM; blade comes out below little-finger side and points diagonally DOWN-RIGHT. Show the back of right hand/knuckles to camera so grip can be inspected. Pommel above thumb, small crossguard below little finger, blade below guard. The hilt must NOT run along the forearm; it is across the fist, blade downward. Do not turn wrist at 90 degrees. Only one knife, no blade from thumb side, no fused finger/guard.
LEFT arm is EMPTY, held back for balance: clearly visible left upper arm and elbow, elbow softly bent, left forearm trails BACK-LEFT beside hip; LEFT hand naturally relaxed, five normal fingers with thumb on correct side, do not spread into a claw. Both hands fully visible, away from face, belt and cape, without overlap that conceals anatomy. Lunge and dagger read as the end of a downward close slash. Look toward right with focus, face recognizable.
Same realistic painted dark-fantasy style as reference, rich worn materials, muted palette, cool soft light and restrained warm rim. No new accessories, no 3D or cartoon. Keep whole character, boots, bow, cloak and dagger INSIDE canvas with at least 5% transparent padding; requested1536x2048 portrait. True transparent background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no opponent, no effects. Prioritize coherent anatomy and a credible secure reverse grip over extreme foreshortening.
